title: Closed-complement vanishing for proper pushforward of open extension
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of positive characteristic different from $\ell$; all schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$ and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be admissible [sk-def-localizing-closure], with the finite-subextension condensed ring of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed] for $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use ordinary unbounded module-object derived categories and total derived pushpull [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and exact termwise open extension by zero [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. Let $r:W\to\overline Y$ be a morphism, $i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y$ a quasi-compact open immersion, $U=W\times_{\overline Y}Y$, and $j:U\hookrightarrow W$, $p:U\to Y$ the projections [def-pc-fibre-product; def-weil-open-immersion]. Assume $r$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $c:Z\hookrightarrow\overline Y$ be the reduced closed complement of $i(Y)$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then for every bounded constructible complex of finite Tor amplitude $A\in\Dctf(U,\Lambda)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible], $$c^*Rr_*j_!A\simeq0\quad\text{in }D(Z_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Lambda).$$ This is a statement about the target object alone, with no comparison morphism or localizing-closure conclusion.
